mapper.insert: INSERT INTO rt_grant ( id, parent_id, root_principal, on_behalf_of, chain_json, depth, body_json, hash, status, expires_at, create_at ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{parentId}, #{rootPrincipal}, #{onBehalfOf}, #{chainJson}, #{depth}, #{bodyJson}, #{hash}, #{status}, #{expiresAt}, now() )
mapper.select: SELECT id, parent_id AS parentId, root_principal AS rootPrincipal, on_behalf_of AS onBehalfOf, chain_json AS chainJson, depth, body_json AS bodyJson, hash, status, expires_at AS expiresAt, create_at AS createAt, ended_at AS endedAt FROM rt_grant WHERE id = #{id}

WITH RECURSIVE descendants AS ( SELECT id, parent_id FROM rt_grant WHERE id = #{grantId} UNION ALL SELECT g.id, g.parent_id FROM rt_grant g JOIN descendants d ON g.parent_id = d.id ) SELECT d.id FROM descendants d JOIN rt_grant r ON r.id = d.id WHERE r.status = 'ACTIVE'
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(prompt_tokens, 0) + COALESCE(completion_tokens, 0)), 0) FROM runtime_turn WHERE thread_id = #{threadId}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM runtime_thread th JOIN runtime_turn t ON t.thread_id = th.id WHERE th.parent_turn_id = #{parentTurnId} AND t.status IN ('QUEUED', 'RUNNING', 'WAITING_CHILD', 'WAITING_APPROVAL', 'INTERRUPTED')
SELECT id FROM runtime_thread WHERE parent_turn_id = #{parentTurnId}
